column2: The consignor packed the goods and handed them to the carrier on Tuesday.
column3: 發貨人把貨物包裝好，並於週二交給承運人。
column4: the consignor and consignee (發貨人與收貨人)
column5: consign 託付 + or 做的人：把貨託出去的人

column2: We paid extra demurrage because the containers stayed at the port for ten days.
column3: 因為貨櫃在港口停留了十天，我們多付了延滯費。
column5: de-MUR-rage 像「地磨蹭」：貨櫃在港口磨蹭要罰錢

column2: Both sides follow Incoterms to decide who pays for shipping and insurance.
column3: 雙方依照國貿條規來決定誰支付運費與保險。
column5: Inter 國際 + Commercial 商業 + Terms 條款的縮寫

column2: The price is quoted free on board, so the buyer pays for shipping after loading.
column3: 價格以離岸價報出，所以貨物裝船後的運費由買方負擔。
column4: priced free on board (以離岸價計價)
column5: free 免除 + on board 上船：賣方管到貨上船為止

column2: The quotation shows a cost, insurance, and freight price, so the seller arranges shipping.
column3: 報價單顯示的是到岸價，所以由賣方安排運輸。
column4: quoted at cost insurance freight (以到岸價報價)
column5: cost 成本 + insurance 保險 + freight 運費全包

column2: The importer asked its bank to open a letter of credit before the goods were shipped.
column3: 進口商要求銀行在貨物出貨前開立信用狀。
column4: open a letter of credit (開立信用狀)
column5: letter 信 + credit 信用：銀行寫信保證會付錢

column2: Her monthly remittance helps her family in Vietnam pay school fees.
column3: 她每個月的匯款幫助越南的家人支付學費。
column5: re 回 + mit 送：把錢送回老家

column2: We prefer a wire transfer because the money reaches the supplier in one day.
column3: 我們偏好電匯，因為款項一天內就能到達供應商。
column4: pay by wire transfer (以電匯付款)
column5: wire 電線 + transfer 轉移：錢順著電線飛過去

column2: Check clearing usually takes two business days before the funds appear in your account.
column3: 支票清算通常需要兩個工作天，款項才會出現在你的帳戶。
column5: clear 清楚：讓帳目結清乾淨

column2: The settlement date for the share purchase is two business days after the trade.
column3: 這筆股票買賣的交割日是交易後的兩個工作日。
column5: settle 安定、結清 + ment：帳款在這天了結

column2: Our sales manager spends two weeks overseas every spring visiting distributors.
column3: 我們的業務經理每年春天都會花兩週到海外拜訪經銷商。
column5: over 越過 + seas 海洋：飛越大海到國外

column2: As a multinational firm, it runs factories in twelve countries.
column3: 作為一家跨國企業，它在十二個國家經營工廠。
column5: multi 很多 + national 國家的：好多國家都有

column2: Globalization has made it easy for a small shop to sell goods to buyers worldwide.
column3: 全球化讓小店也能輕易把商品賣給世界各地的買家。
column5: globe 地球 + ization：讓整個地球連成一體

column2: Outsourcing payroll to a specialist firm saved the company about forty thousand dollars a year.
column3: 把薪資作業外包給專業公司，為公司每年省下大約四萬美元。
column5: out 外面 + source 來源：把工作往外找人做

column2: Many retailers outsource customer service to call centers in other countries.
column3: 許多零售商把客戶服務外包給其他國家的客服中心。
column5: out 外面 + source 來源：向外找來源

column2: Offshoring moved the factory's assembly lines to a country with lower wages.
column3: 境外外包讓工廠的裝配線移到薪資較低的國家。
column5: off 離開 + shore 海岸：離開本國海岸去海外做

column2: Reshoring brought the company's production back to Taiwan after shipping costs rose.
column3: 運費上漲後，產線回流把公司的生產帶回了台灣。
column5: re 回 + shore 海岸：從外地搬回自家海岸

column2: A storm at the port disrupted the supply chain and delayed holiday toy shipments.
column3: 港口的暴風雨擾亂了供應鏈，延誤了節慶玩具的出貨。
column4: a global supply chain (全球供應鏈)
column5: supply 供應 + chain 鎖鏈：一環扣一環才送到手

column2: The lead time for custom furniture is six weeks from the day you order.
column3: 客製家具的交期是從下單當天起算六週。
column5: lead 引導在前 + time 時間：下單前導到交貨的時間

column2: The repair shop's turnaround time is two days, so your phone will be ready by Friday.
column3: 維修店的處理週轉時間是兩天，所以你的手機週五前會好。
column4: fast turnaround time (快速的週轉時間)
column5: turn around 轉一圈：收件到交回走完一圈要多久

column2: Punctuality is important in our office, so please arrive before the meeting begins.
column3: 在我們辦公室守時很重要，所以請在會議開始前到達。
column5: punctual 守時 + ity：名詞，準時這件事

column2: Our driver is always punctual, so the shuttle leaves the hotel at exactly eight.
column3: 我們的司機總是很準時，所以接駁車正好在八點離開飯店。
column5: punct 點 + ual：準時對準那個「點」到

column2: Fridays are business casual at our firm, so jeans and polo shirts are fine.
column3: 我們公司週五是商務休閒日，所以穿牛仔褲和 polo 衫都可以。
column4: business casual dress (商務休閒穿著)
column5: business 上班 + casual 隨意：上班但穿得輕鬆

column2: The dress code for the conference requires a jacket and tie for men.
column3: 研討會的服裝規定要求男士穿外套並打領帶。
column4: follow the dress code (遵守服裝規定)
column5: dress 穿著 + code 規則：穿衣服的規定密碼

column2: Formal attire is required at the awards dinner, so rent a suit or a dress.
column3: 頒獎晚宴要求穿著正式服裝，所以請租一套西裝或洋裝。
column5: attire 像「愛鐵兒」：愛鐵兒穿得整齊體面

column2: Good ergonomics, such as an adjustable chair, can reduce back pain among office workers.
column3: 良好的人體工學設計，例如可調式座椅，可以減少上班族的背痛。
column5: ergo 工作 + nomics 法則：研究工作怎麼坐才舒服

column2: Each employee has a small cubicle with a desk and a tall partition.
column3: 每位員工都有一個小隔間，裡面有書桌和高高的隔板。
column4: work in a cubicle (在隔間辦公)
column5: cube 立方體：像一個小方盒子

column2: The stationery cabinet is full of pens, notepads, and envelopes for the whole floor.
column3: 文具櫃裡擺滿了全樓層用的筆、便條紙和信封。
column5: station 站 + ery：在文具店站著賣的紙筆

column2: Please use the stapler to attach the cover page to the contract.
column3: 請用釘書機把封面頁釘在合約上。
column4: staple pages with a stapler (用釘書機裝訂)
column5: staple 釘書針 + er：會釘的工具

column2: She fixed the receipt to the expense form with a paperclip.
column3: 她用迴紋針把收據固定在費用表單上。
column4: attach with a paperclip (用迴紋針固定)
column5: paper 紙 + clip 夾子：夾紙的小東西

column2: The trainer wrote the key steps on the whiteboard for everyone to copy.
column3: 講師把關鍵步驟寫在白板上，讓大家抄寫。
column4: write on the whiteboard (寫在白板上)
column5: white 白色 + board 板子：白色的板子

column2: Please connect your laptop to the projector so the slides appear on the wall.
column3: 請將你的筆電連接到投影機，讓簡報出現在牆上。
column4: turn on the projector (打開投影機)
column5: project 投射 + or 器具：把畫面丟到牆上

column2: All correspondence with clients must be filed so that we can track earlier requests.
column3: 所有與客戶的往來信件都必須歸檔，以便我們追蹤先前的要求。
column5: cor 互相 + respond 回應：互相回信的內容

column2: The recipient of the package must show an ID card at the front desk.
column3: 包裹的收件人必須在櫃台出示身分證。
column5: receive 接收 + ent：接到東西的人

column2: If the sender's address is missing, the post office cannot return the letter.
column3: 如果缺少寄件人地址，郵局就無法退回這封信。
column5: send 送出 + er 人：把東西送出的人

column2: Use a clear subject line so the manager knows the email is urgent.
column3: 請使用清楚的主旨列，好讓經理知道這封郵件很緊急。
column4: write a subject line (撰寫主旨列)
column5: subject 主題 + line 一行：信上的主題那一行

column2: I forgot to open the attachment, so I did not see the price list.
column3: 我忘了打開附件，所以沒看到價目表。
column5: attach 附上 + ment：附在信上的東西

column2: The email ended with a disclaimer saying the company is not responsible for any errors.
column3: 這封電子郵件以免責聲明結尾，說明公司對任何錯誤概不負責。
column5: dis 否認 + claim 主張：聲明我不負這個責任

column2: The hotel manager gave us a cordial welcome and a free cup of tea.
column3: 飯店經理熱誠地歡迎我們，還送了一杯免費的茶。
column5: cord 心：從心裡出來的熱情

column2: We appreciate the promptness of your reply, which helped us finish the order on time.
column3: 我們感謝您迅速的回覆，讓我們得以準時完成訂單。
column5: prompt 迅速 + ness：做事快的程度
